Senses.Explanation: To emerge bodily is to come out from a stated confinement or position and show a road of emergence. Chongsheng Yi says a road out is still required; an unnamed monk asks Shan Shan Zhijian where the buddhas emerge; Linji Yixuan and Yunfeng Wenyue use the same wording in sharply different statements. The word marks coming out, not a general imported theory of liberation.
